path: ServerScriptService/ForgeChecks.server.luau
purpose: Feature: Create executable checks (forge checks --plan) that run a live playtest and assert the telemetry counters: map_built=1, plaza_built=1, themes_built=6, plot_assigned (after claim or the 20s auto-claim), auto_claims, cubes_dropped rising about every 2s, cubes_collected rising, cashin_fx_sent>0, and Cash rising. Also assert that there are no output errors or warnings and that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim. Run them, then hand any failing check to the fixer. Keep existing counter names unchanged. -- Studio-only runner (returns immediately unless RunService:IsStudio()) that executes the plan from ForgeChecksPlan. It subscribes to LogService.MessageOut from the start and records Error and Warning entries, ignoring lines that start with its own '[ForgeCheck]' prefix. It waits for the first player and for map_built, plaza_built and themes_built, then snapshots telemetry through ForgeTelemetry.get/snapshot. During the pre-claim window it samples cubes_dropped and plot_assigned and records whether cubes_dropped stayed 0 before any claim. Claim phase: in 'auto' mode it waits for the 20s auto-claim and asserts plot_assigned and auto_claims rose. In 'gate' mode (Workspace attribute ForgeCheckMode='gate') it pivots the player's character onto the first unclaimed gate part to trigger the real Touched claim and asserts plots_claimed and plot_assigned rose. After the claim it samples cubes_dropped, cubes_collected and the player's leaderstats Cash every 2.5s for about 4 windows, then checks cashin_fx_sent>0 and the Output log. For each check it prints one line, '[ForgeCheck] PASS <id>' or '[ForgeCheck] FAIL <id> expected=<..> actual=<..>' (via print, never warn), then a final single line '[ForgeCheck] RESULT {json}' with {passed, failed, failures:[{id, expected, actual}]} that the CLI parses to hand each failing check to the fixer. It sets Workspace attribute ForgeChecksDone=true when finished. It only reads game state and never mutates cash, plots or existing counters. It bumps only its own counters 'checks_passed' and 'checks_failed' with ForgeTelemetry.count. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: checks_passed, checks_failed.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/ForgeChecksPlan.luau, ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau

```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeChecksPlan: pure data describing the live playtest check plan.
-- No services, no side effects. A runner reads this table, samples telemetry
-- counters, evaluates each check, and reports checks_passed / checks_failed.

export type Check = {
	id: string,
	kind: string,
	counter: string?,
	expect: any,
	modes: { string }?, -- if present, the check only runs in these claim modes
	description: string?,
}

local Plan = {
	-- Timing (seconds)
	settleSeconds = 3, -- startup settle before the first sample
	preClaimWindow = 8, -- observe before any claim (shorter than the 20s auto-claim)
	sampleInterval = 2.5, -- spacing between counter samples
	maxTotalSeconds = 50, -- hard cap for the whole run
	autoClaimSeconds = 20, -- the game's auto-claim deadline (informational)

	-- 'auto' waits for the auto-claim; 'gate' walks the character onto a gate
	claimMode = "auto",

	-- Counter names the runner bumps through ForgeTelemetry (server side)
	telemetry = {
		passed = "checks_passed",
		failed = "checks_failed",
	},

	-- Counters and values the runner samples
	counters = {
		"map_built",
		"plaza_built",
		"themes_built",
		"plot_assigned",
		"plots_claimed",
		"auto_claims",
		"cubes_dropped",
		"cubes_collected",
		"cashin_fx_sent",
	},
	cashStat = { folder = "leaderstats", name = "Cash" },

	-- Rising windows: cubes_dropped must grow by >= minGrowth in each window after claim.
	-- No upper bound, so a faster rate after Dropper 2 is tolerated.
	risingWindow = {
		counter = "cubes_dropped",
		windowSeconds = 2.5,
		minGrowth = 1,
		allowFaster = true,
	},

	-- Log messages of these types count as output failures
	badOutputTypes = { "Error", "Warning" },

	checks = ({
		{
			id = "map_built_once",
			kind = "counter_eq",
			counter = "map_built",
			expect = 1,
			description = "Map is built once at startup",
		},
		{
			id = "plaza_built_once",
			kind = "counter_eq",
			counter = "plaza_built",
			expect = 1,
			description = "Plaza is built once at startup",
		},
		{
			id = "themes_built_six",
			kind = "counter_eq",
			counter = "themes_built",
			expect = 6,
			description = "Six themed plots exist",
		},
		{
			id = "no_drops_before_claim",
			kind = "zero_before_claim",
			counter = "cubes_dropped",
			expect = 0,
			description = "cubes_dropped stays 0 while plot_assigned == 0",
		},
		{
			id = "plot_assigned",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "plot_assigned",
			expect = 1,
			description = "A plot is assigned after claim or auto-claim",
		},
		{
			id = "auto_claims",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "auto_claims",
			expect = 1,
			modes = { "auto" },
			description = "Auto-claim fires for an idle player",
		},
		{
			id = "cubes_dropped_rising",
			kind = "rising_windows",
			counter = "cubes_dropped",
			expect = 1,
			description = "cubes_dropped grows >= 1 in each 2.5s window after claim",
		},
		{
			id = "cubes_collected",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "cubes_collected",
			expect = 1,
			description = "Cubes reach the collector",
		},
		{
			id = "cashin_fx_sent",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "cashin_fx_sent",
			expect = 1,
			description = "Cash-in effects were sent to the client",
		},
		{
			id = "cash_rising",
			kind = "cash_rising",
			counter = nil,
			expect = true,
			description = "Cash leaderstat is higher than at claim time",

			id = "no_output_errors",
			kind = "no_output_errors",
			counter = nil,
			expect = 0,
			description = "No Error or Warning messages in the log",
		},
	} :: { Check }),
}

return Plan
```

### ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau
```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry
```

# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~10-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly.
- Keep tutorial text consistent with the actual flow (e.g. don't say "walk to a gate" if auto-claim happens within seconds). Tutorial steps must be advanced by events that actually occur, or the player is left without guidance.
- Feedback should be audible and visible: use verified sound ids from the shared asset table, not weak built-in rbxasset wavs. Add particles or ambient sparkle, and set the bloom threshold low enough that Neon parts glow.
- Shared effect helpers (burst, shake, sound) only matter if gameplay code calls them. Wire each helper to a real event (collect, buy, rebirth) and check that its counter is above 0 after a playtest.

```luau
-- ForgeChecks: Studio-only live playtest runner. Reads telemetry, never mutates game state.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then
	return
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PREFIX = "[ForgeCheck]"

-- Record log output from the very start (before any waits).
local badLogs: { string } = {}
LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message: string, messageType: Enum.MessageType)
	if messageType ~= Enum.MessageType.MessageError and messageType ~= Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then
		return
	end
	if string.sub(message, 1, #PREFIX) == PREFIX then
		return
	end
	table.insert(badLogs, (if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then "Error: " else "Warning: ") .. message)
end)

local Plan = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeChecksPlan", 10))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 10))

local startTime = os.clock()

local function val(name: string): number
	local v = ForgeTelemetry.get()[name]
	return if type(v) == "number" then v else 0
end

local function waitFor(cond: () -> boolean, timeout: number, step: number?): boolean
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
		if cond() then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(step or 0.25)
	end
	return cond()
end

local function getCash(player: Player?): number?
	if not player then
		return nil
	end
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild(Plan.cashStat.folder)
	local cash = ls and ls:FindFirstChild(Plan.cashStat.name)
	if cash and (cash:IsA("IntValue") or cash:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return (cash :: NumberValue).Value
	end
	return nil
end

local function findGate(): BasePart?
	for _, d in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") and string.sub(d.Text, 1, 5) == "Claim" then
			local gui = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("BillboardGui")
			if gui then
				local part: Instance? = gui.Adornee or gui.Parent
				if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
					return part
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, d in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), "gate") and d.Transparency < 1 then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- State gathered during the run
local mode = Workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeCheckMode") == "gate" and "gate" or (Plan.claimMode or "auto")
local player: Player? = nil
local zeroBeforeClaim = true
local preSamples = 0
local maxDropsPre = 0
local claimed = false
local baseline = { plot_assigned = 0, plots_claimed = 0, auto_claims = 0 }
local dropSamples: { number } = {}
local collectedSamples: { number } = {}
local cashSamples: { number } = {}
local claimCash: number? = nil
local extraNotes: { string } = {}

local function run()
	-- wait for first player
	waitFor(function()
		return #Players:GetPlayers() > 0
	end, 30, 0.25)
	player = Players:GetPlayers()[1]

	-- wait for startup counters
	waitFor(function()
		return val("map_built") >= 1 and val("plaza_built") >= 1 and val("themes_built") >= 1
	end, 20, 0.25)

	task.wait(Plan.settleSeconds)
	baseline.plot_assigned = val("plot_assigned")
	baseline.plots_claimed = val("plots_claimed")
	baseline.auto_claims = val("auto_claims")

	-- pre-claim window
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < Plan.preClaimWindow do
		local drops = val("cubes_dropped") -- read drops first, then assigned (drops imply assigned)
		local assigned = val("plot_assigned")
		preSamples += 1
		if assigned <= baseline.plot_assigned and assigned == 0 then
			if drops > 0 then
				zeroBeforeClaim = false
				maxDropsPre = math.max(maxDropsPre, drops)
			end
		end
		if assigned > baseline.plot_assigned then
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end

	-- claim phase
	if mode == "gate" then
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			if val("plot_assigned") > baseline.plot_assigned then
				break
			end
			local char = player and player.Character
			if player and not char then
				waitFor(function()
					return player.Character ~= nil
				end, 8, 0.25)
				char = player.Character
			end
			local gate = findGate()
			if char and gate then
				pcall(function()
					char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(gate.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
				end)
			else
				table.insert(extraNotes, "gate_or_character_missing")
			end
			waitFor(function()
				return val("plot_assigned") > baseline.plot_assigned
			end, 4, 0.25)
		end
	else
		waitFor(function()
			return val("plot_assigned") > baseline.plot_assigned
		end, Plan.autoClaimSeconds + 8, 0.25)
	end
	claimed = val("plot_assigned") > baseline.plot_assigned

	-- post-claim sampling
	claimCash = getCash(player)
	table.insert(dropSamples, val("cubes_dropped"))
	table.insert(collectedSamples, val("cubes_collected"))
	table.insert(cashSamples, claimCash or 0)
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		task.wait(Plan.sampleInterval)
		table.insert(dropSamples, val("cubes_dropped"))
		table.insert(collectedSamples, val("cubes_collected"))
		table.insert(cashSamples, getCash(player) or 0)
	end
	task.wait(0.5) -- let late FX counters land
end

local ok, err = pcall(run)
local results: { { id: string, pass: boolean, expected: string, actual: string } } = {}

local function add(id: string, pass: boolean, expected: any, actual: any)
	table.insert(results, { id = id, pass = pass, expected = tostring(expected), actual = tostring(actual) })
end

if not ok then
	add("runner_error", false, "no error", tostring(err))
end

local finalSnap = ForgeTelemetry.get()
local function fv(name: string): number
	local v = finalSnap[name]
	return if type(v) == "number" then v else 0
end

for _, check in Plan.checks do
	local applies = true
	if check.modes then
		applies = table.find(check.modes, mode) ~= nil
	end
	if applies then
		local kind = check.kind
		local counter = check.counter
		if kind == "counter_eq" and counter then
			add(check.id, fv(counter) == check.expect, check.expect, fv(counter))
		elseif kind == "counter_gte" and counter then
			local actual = fv(counter)
			local pass = actual >= check.expect
			if counter == "plot_assigned" then
				pass = pass and actual > baseline.plot_assigned
			elseif counter == "auto_claims" then
				pass = pass and actual > baseline.auto_claims
			end
			add(check.id, pass, ">=" .. tostring(check.expect), actual)
		elseif kind == "zero_before_claim" then
			add(check.id, zeroBeforeClaim and preSamples > 0, "cubes_dropped=0 before claim",
				if zeroBeforeClaim then ("0 over " .. preSamples .. " samples") else ("cubes_dropped=" .. maxDropsPre))
		elseif kind == "rising_windows" then
			local minGrowth = Plan.risingWindow.minGrowth
			local growths: { string } = {}
			local pass = #dropSamples >= 2
			for i = 2, #dropSamples do
				local g = dropSamples[i] - dropSamples[i - 1]
				table.insert(growths, tostring(g))
				if g < minGrowth then
					pass = false
				end
			end
			add(check.id, pass, ">=" .. minGrowth .. " per window", "[" .. table.concat(growths, ",") .. "]")
		elseif kind == "cash_rising" then
			local base = claimCash
			local maxCash = 0
			for _, c in cashSamples do
				maxCash = math.max(maxCash, c)
			end
			local pass = base ~= nil and maxCash > base
			add(check.id, pass, "cash > claim cash", "claim=" .. tostring(base) .. " max=" .. tostring(maxCash))
		elseif kind == "no_output_errors" then
			add(check.id, #badLogs == 0, 0, if #badLogs == 0 then 0 else (#badLogs .. " first=" .. string.sub(badLogs[1], 1, 160)))
		else
			add(check.id, false, "known check kind", tostring(kind))
		end
	end
end

if mode == "gate" then
```
